title: Reactivity Series
content: The Reactivity Series of metals is the arrangement of metals in the decreasing order of reactivity; the more reactive metals are easy to lose electrons and form positive ions[cite: 1].

title: Ores
content: Ores are the minerals from which the metals can be extracted conveniently and economically[cite: 1].

title: Gangue
content: Gangue is the earthy impurities (sand, silt, gravel, etc.) associated with the ore[cite: 1].

title: Metallurgy
content: Metallurgy is the process used for the extraction of pure metals from their ores[cite: 1].

title: Ductility
content: Ductility of a material is the ability to stretch under tensile stress[cite: 1].

title: Malleability
content: Malleability is the ability of a material to be shaped under force or pressure is exerted on it[cite: 1].

title: Thermite Reaction
content: Thermite reaction is a chemical reaction in which a lot of heat is released as a metal oxide is displaced by another metal which is more reactive than the metal in the metal oxide[cite: 1].

title: Alloy
content: An alloy is a mixture of metals with other elements (usually metals) but sometimes carbons, especially to give greater strength or resistance to corrosion[cite: 1].

title: Steel
content: Steel is a mixture of the metal iron and the non-metal carbon[cite: 1].

title: Corrosion
content: Corrosion is the deterioration of metals as a result of chemical reaction depending on the type of metal and the environmental conditions[cite: 1].
